prompt: Create one beautifully drawn, professional educational illustration sheet: exactly TWO equal panels SIDE BY SIDE, each on pure white, no visible frame, generous empty margins. NO TEXT, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks. Polished warm editorial illustration with natural perspective, careful proportions, clean organic lines, subtle shading, coral-orange, teal and navy accents. Intended for a serious university lecture on the history of embedded AI, matching cheerful elegant textbook illustrations, not geometric placeholder icons. LEFT PANEL: an artist's historically informed reconstruction of SRI's Shakey robot (late 1960s): tall narrow light-grey metal rectangular cabinet on a compact wheeled base with two visible large dark wheels; a slender mast above the cabinet supporting a box-shaped old television camera with a clear round lens, radio aerial. It stands in a simple indoor laboratory with a couple of plain wooden obstacle blocks, with a separate period computer console nearby (a small 1960s cabinet/monitor and reel storage), suggesting off-board computing. Make the robot unmistakably a real experimental machine, no face, no humanoid limbs, no futuristic screen. RIGHT PANEL: a tasteful reconstruction of a late-1980s autonomous-driving research vehicle: a pale blue boxy research van, natural three-quarter front view, roof-mounted camera/sensors, travelling along a simple gently bending country road, unobtrusive green verges and one or two trees. Suggest observing the road with a very subtle translucent teal camera field, no glowing beams or fantasy technology. No logos, brand names or real researcher portraits. Both are schematic historical reconstructions, NOT claimed photographs or exact archival replicas. Render both scenes with equal visual weight and sufficient detail to be attractive at slide scale, but uncluttered. Landscape aspect ratio, two balanced panels.
